facts.text: The critical path is the longest chain of dependent tasks in a plan, so any delay on that chain delays the end date; a buffer is spare time deliberately placed in the plan to absorb delays.
facts.quote: The critical path is the longest chain of dependent tasks in a plan, so any delay on it delays the end date; a buffer is spare time deliberately placed in the plan to absorb such delays.

facts.text: The critical path method (CPM) is the model that schedule-risk tools work on.
facts.quote: The method is called the critical path method (CPM) and is the model that schedule-risk tools work on [Chapter 12].

facts.text: The booklet rejects adding 20% buffer everywhere as indefensible and recommends placing uncertainty allowances where uncertainty exists: model accuracy, data access, hardware lead time, integration, safety review and rework.
facts.quote: The booklet rejects "add 20% everywhere" as indefensible and asks for uncertainty to be put where it exists: model accuracy, data access, hardware lead time, integration, safety review and rework.

facts.text: The booklet recommends a schedule buffer before the first physical-correlation test.
facts.quote: It asks for a buffer before the first physical-correlation test

facts.text: The booklet's reviewer checklist asks where the integration buffer is and what happens if test slots slip four weeks.
facts.quote: its reviewer checklist asks where the integration buffer is and what happens if test slots slip four weeks [Chapter 12].

facts.text: The Critical Chain method pools buffers at the end of chains and is described as popular but unproven.
facts.quote: The Critical Chain method, which pools buffers at the end of chains, is described as popular but unproven [Chapter 12].

facts.text: An unconfirmed sensor choice is identified as the collision-mitigation program's single largest schedule risk because sensor models, logged data and false-positive behavior are all sensor-specific.
facts.quote: An unconfirmed sensor choice is called "the single largest schedule risk", because sensor models, logged data and false-positive behavior are all specific to the sensor [Chapter 2].

facts.text: Review queues and independent retesting can become the collision-mitigation program's critical path.
facts.quote: Review queues and independent retesting can become the critical path [Chapter 1].

facts.text: The hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) bench should not be on the collision-mitigation program's critical path unless the electronic control unit (ECU), bus and actuator interfaces stabilize early.
facts.quote: The hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) bench "should not be on the critical path unless ECU, bus and actuator interfaces stabilize early", the ECU being the machine's electronic control unit [Chapter 1].

facts.text: For a program with a fixed end date, the critical path identifies which slips matter and where a buffer provides the most protection.
facts.quote: With a fixed end date, the critical path tells management which slips matter and where a buffer buys the most protection

facts.text: The booklet asks management to identify the date at which scope must be reduced to preserve delivery confidence.
facts.quote: the booklet asks at what date scope must be reduced to preserve delivery confidence [Chapter 12].
